question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Entice
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"entice"** means to attract or tempt by offering pleasure or advantage. (लुभाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The aroma of fresh bread can entice customers into the bakery.
 
 
 
• **"Repulse" **means to drive back or repel, particularly with force or disgust. (घृणा करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The sight of the spoiled food repulsed him, and he immediately threw it away.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'entice' **is **'repulse'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Allure **(आकर्षण): The quality of being powerfully and mysteriously attractive or fascinating.

 
 
• **Example:** The allure of the city lights drew her to the bustling streets of New York.
 
 
 
• **Invite **(आमंत्रित करना): To make a polite, formal, or friendly request to someone to go somewhere or to do something.
 
 
• **Example: **She decided to invite all her friends to the party.
 
 
 
• **Tangle** (उलझन): To become or cause to become twisted together with or caught in.
 
 
• **Example:** The kite got tangled in the tree branches.
